sentences.text: The FIR in the present case is premised on a complaint of the respondent no.2 who is stated to have paid a sum of Rs.11,50,000/- to the Presidium School, Sector-16B, Dwarka where the son of the respondent no.2 was studying and the petitioner was the Vice Principal.
5. The parties have settled all their disputes and claims against each other in terms of the Compromise Deed dated 13th December, 2023, which is filed as Annexure 4, to the present petition.
6. As per the Compromise Deed, it is agreed that a sum of Rs.11,50,000/- shall be paid by the petitioner to the respondent no.2 towards full and final settlement.
Out of the aforesaid amount, the petitioner has already handed over a demand draft of Rs.6,00,000/- to the respondent no.2.

For the balance amount, the petitioner has brought a demand draft of Rs.5,50,000/- in Court today and the same has been handed over to the respondent no.2.
7. Issue Notice.

8. Notice is accepted by the learned ASC appearing on behalf of the State and the counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no.2.
9.
Learned ASC submits that during investigation, the petitioner had disputed her identity.
However, the petitioner who is present in the Court admits that she is the person named in the FIR.
10. The respondent no.2 is present in the Court and has been identified by his counsel and by the Investigating Officer (IO).
He informs the Court that he has settled the matter of his own free will and without any coercion.
He further states that he does not wish to pursue the present FIR any further and has no objection if the present petition is allowed.
11. The petitioner is present in Court and has been identified by her This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 01:03:49 counsel and the IO.
She affirms the statement of the respondent no.2 and undertakes to abide by the terms of settlement arrived at between the parties.
12. Counsel for the respondent no.2 submits that the present petition be adjourned so that the aforesaid demand drafts are duly encashed.
13. In view thereof, list on 22nd December, 2023.

AMIT BANSAL, J.
DECEMBER 18, 2023 at
